notes: C++ is compiled by Piston as `g++ -std=c++17` (no -O2); Java runs the single-file launcher (javac inside the run stage).
Times are Piston-reported per stage; clientMs is the HTTP round trip seen by this script (includes queueing).
meta.cleaning: kept: correct samples and genuine timeouts; excluded: HTTP 400, client timeouts, CPU-overlap, sleep and post-resume samples, false timeouts (see exclusions.json, evidence.json)
